## Cat Key 1.7.1: eight new app packs

**⬇ [Download for Windows](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-Setup-x64.exe)** or the [portable exe](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-portable-x64.exe) · **[Download for Mac](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-mac.dmg)** (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11+).

### New in the Library
The Library now has 30 packs and 1,097 shortcuts. Each new one was checked against the maker's own shortcut page:
- **Notion:** search and jump, text, making blocks (headings, to-dos, lists) and moving them.
- **Slack:** getting around (unreads, threads, DMs), writing, huddles.
- **Word, Excel and PowerPoint** (Windows): styles and layout, number formats and AutoSum, slides and objects.
- **Final Cut Pro** (Mac): tools, editing, effects, marking and playback.
- **Ableton Live:** views, clips, recording and MIDI editing, with the Mac keys where they differ.
- **Unity:** tools, GameObjects, play mode and the editor windows.
- A new **Music & audio** shelf, and **Scan my apps** now spots all of these.

### Still new from 1.7.0
- **App switcher:** rest the pointer in a corner and your open windows pop up right there. Click one to jump to it (Settings → App switcher).

**Mac, first open:** Cat Key isn't notarized by Apple yet. Open it once, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. If that goes round in circles, paste this into Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Cat Key.app" && open "/Applications/Cat Key.app"`.
